PROCESS FIXES EARNED TONIGHT:

PO-7: THE RELEASE-CUT COMMIT IS ONE COMMIT. VERSION, every manifest, every
install page and CHECKSUMS.sha256 land together, and the tag goes on that
commit. A pinned test compares the tag against `git log -1 --format=%H --
VERSION`, so splitting them makes the tag and VERSION disagree about which
commit is the release. Cost tonight: a soft reset of three commits.

PO-8: THE TAG COMES BEFORE THE BATTERY, NOT AFTER. One install assertion
cannot pass until the tag exists, so a battery run before tagging is
guaranteed to report one failure. Cut the tag locally (reversible until
pushed), confirm the docs suite is green, then run the battery once, then
push.

PO-9: PASS --session TO EVERY bm_store.py CALL. Each shell invocation
otherwise mints its own session id, so a fence claimed from the command line
can never be parked by a later call. Worse: the id the WRITE HOOK uses is not
the conversation id either, so claiming with the wrong one locks you out of
your own files. Take the id from the hook's own refusal message. The way out
is adopt then park, in that order, and adopting a one-shot CLI session needs
--adopt-from-live-session.

PO-10: A SHELL SCAN MUST REPORT ITS RESULT, NOT ITS LABEL. `grep pattern |
head -n && echo FOUND` always prints FOUND because head exits 0. Read the
matched lines; never trust the trailing echo.
<!-- bm-human:end -->
